comment: Which store email identity RMA notification emails are sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity used for RMA (return) notification emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2) configured under *General → Store Email Addresses*. Can be set per store view.

comment: The file types customers may attach to an RMA request.
modal: The set of file extensions accepted for attachments on a return request; files of other types are rejected. Can differ per website.
